title: Minimize Inversions in a Prefix Tree
statement: The task is to order the children of every node of a trie (prefix tree) built from n ≤ 10^4 distinct words over letters 'a'–'j' so that the pre-order traversal of word indices has the fewest inversions against a target permutation. Each pair is decided at its branching node, so each node independently orders at most 10 children by pairwise cross-inversion counts using a bitmask DP over subsets.
